# Clearly, AI

> A plain-English AI school for non-technical adults. Learn it. Use it. Own it.

Clearly, AI teaches working professionals, small business owners, retirees, and curious learners how to use artificial intelligence confidently. Every lesson is practical, jargon-free, and designed for people with no technical background. One subscription unlocks all courses.

Founded by Nate Guy. Domain: learnaiclearly.com

## Courses

All courses include 6 modules, ~30 lessons, and approximately 3 hours of content. One subscription unlocks everything.

- [AI Foundations](https://learnaiclearly.com/courses/ai-foundations): The starting point. A plain-English introduction to AI for everyday people — what it is, how to use ChatGPT and other tools from day one, how to write effective prompts, and how to apply AI to writing, research, and planning. For beginners with no tech background.

- [AI at Work](https://learnaiclearly.com/courses/ai-at-work): For working professionals who want to reclaim time and become indispensable. Covers email management, meeting prep and follow-up, turning rough notes into polished reports, and building reusable AI workflows for repetitive tasks.

- [AI for Your Business](https://learnaiclearly.com/courses/ai-for-your-business): For small business owners who wear every hat. Covers customer communications, marketing content without an agency, proposals and SOPs, operations, and competitive research — all without a tech team.

- [AI for a Richer Retirement](https://learnaiclearly.com/courses/ai-richer-retirement): For people who finally have time for what matters. Covers using AI for health questions, staying closer to family, travel planning, creative projects like memoir writing, and staying safe online.

## About

Clearly, AI is an online school focused on making artificial intelligence accessible to non-technical adults. The target audiences are working professionals (35–54), small business owners (38–58), and curious learners and retirees (55–75). Content is always jargon-free, practical, and written in plain English.

Contact: nate@learnaiclearly.com
